Super Sega 8-bit machine core (milestone 1, untested on hardware).

Runs Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000 and SC-3000 software on the Super
Sega machine model: Z80, VDP (Mode 4 at 192/224/240 lines, Game Gear CRAM,
the four TMS9918 picture modes), PSG, the FM unit (a YM2413, as IKAOPLL) in
Master System and Super Sega modes, Sega, Codemasters and Korean mappers,
cartridge saves. Super Sega titles run, but ESAT, the window and text
layers, line tables and unique-cell mode are not drawn yet.

ROMs go in /Assets/supersega/common/. Pocket B = button 1, A = button 2,
Y = auto-fire for button 2 (with that boost on), Select = Pause. In Super
Sega (SS) mode the pad is a Mega Drive pad: B = B, A = C, Y = A, Start =
Start, so buttons 1 and 2 stay on B and A. To move any of these to other
buttons, use Core Settings > Controls. A docked USB keyboard is the
SC-3000 SK-1100 keyboard.

Boost options in the core settings are the machine's enhancement layer. All
but True TMS colours are off by default, which is stock behaviour, and they
act only on Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000 and SC-3000 software (True
TMS colours also acts on Super Sega titles' TMS9918 modes). Leave CPU turbo
off for games with FM music: at turbo, FM writes can be lost.
